questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Which of the following statement(s) is/are false regarding token based authentication?
options: The token generated generally expires after a certain time period, and this time period can also be customized according to the application requirements.
The client must send the token with the first request to authenticate, and need not send the token in the subsequent requests.
The fetch calls to a flask API will fail due to the CORS error by default.
If using flask-security for achieving token based authentication, all the API endpoints are protected by default.
correct_answer: The client must send the token with the first request to authenticate, and need not send the token in the subsequent requests.
If using flask-security for achieving token based authentication, all the API endpoints are protected by default.

Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Consider a logistic regression model that is trained on videos to detect objectionable content. Videos with objectionable content belong to the positive class (label 1 ). Harmless videos belong to the negative class (label 0 ). A good detector should be able to correctly identify almost all videos that are objectionable. If it incorrectly classifies even a single video that has inappropriate content in it, that could have serious consequences, as millions of people might end up watching it. In this process the detector may classify some harmless videos as belonging to the positive class. But that is a price we are willing to pay. How should we choose the threshold (for inference) of this logistic regression model?
options: The threshold should be a low value.
The threshold should be a high value.
The performance of the classifier is independent of the threshold.
questions.correct_answer: The threshold should be a low value.
